name: Banyeres del Penedès (Spain)
description: Dark green field charged at the centre with yellow deer antlers.
history: The official flag of Banyeres del Penedès is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, dark green, with the yellow antlers of the arms, 11/18 of the height and 12/27 of the length of the cloth, at the centre; approved on 9 December 2008 and published in the DOGC on 23 December 2008.
